title: Bounded modular reduction
statement: Let $P$ be a program with word, space, and depth limits, and let $p$ be a procedure index. Suppose procedure $p$ is the modular-reduction body. Let $M,V,fr$ be natural numbers such that $1\le M$, the space limit is at most the word limit, $4V+4M+16$ is at most the word limit, and $fr+\bigl(\lfloor\log_2(V+1)\rfloor+2\bigr)$ is at most the space limit. For any initial memory $\mu$ and integer $x$ with $|x|\le V$, running this procedure at depth $d$ on the arguments $(x,M,fr)$ terminates within $43$ times the binary bit length of $\lfloor |x|/M\rfloor$, plus $34$, steps. It returns the remainder of $x$ modulo $M$ and leaves every memory location below $fr$ unchanged.
